hooks.command: msg="CONTRIBUTING.md -> Pull requests: write for the state the change ends in. State what the change is and why it is right. Leave out the route: attempts made, constraints weighed or overridden, verification performed along the way, and how the decision was reached. Keep a rejected alternative only if someone would otherwise retry it, and give it one line."; jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:$m}}'
hooks.statusMessage: PR body: end state, not route

hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$c" in *"git commit"*) msg="CONTRIBUTING.md -> Pull requests: write for the state the change ends in. The commit message states what the change is and why it is right, not the route taken to it. A squash erases the branch history, so narration of attempts and deliberation reaches no one.";; *"gh pr create"*|*"gh pr edit"*) msg="CONTRIBUTING.md -> Pull requests: write for the state the change ends in. State what the change is and why it is right. Leave out the route: attempts made, constraints weighed or overridden, verification performed along the way, and how the decision was reached. Keep a rejected alternative only if someone would otherwise retry it, and give it one line.";; *) exit 0;; esac; jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:$m}}'
